main.description: Resolve a batch of post URIs for the caller, one item per URI. A post is returned only when the server can check that its author and the caller have no block; an author the caller has a block with gives a gap that says which way, and one the server cannot check gives 'block-state-unknown'. Requires auth. Who may call is the server's setting: any signed-in account, or only members whose account is ready, in which case anyone else is refused NotEnrolled or NotReady. A caller that is not a ready member gets viewer.blockedBy and viewer.muted false in the views and no other viewer state. Items carry no continuation markers.

items.description: One item per input URI, in input order.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Malformed request body, or too many URIs.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a member.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account is not ready yet.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
